product.olivetti-snx-200-rs.summary: The tower Systema with room for 2 processors.
product.olivetti-snx-200-rs.history: The SNX 200 was part of Systema before the 460 announcement in December 1995. The guide identifies the RS tower variant.
product.olivetti-snx-200-rs.architecture: Processors could be added on cards. The 64-bit Corollary C-Bus II connects up to 2 processor cards to memory.
product.olivetti-snx-200-rs.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-200-rs.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-snx-200-rs.service-guid: Olivetti, SNX / NetStrada – Pocket Service Guide, ch. 3
product.olivetti-snx-200-rs.computerwoch: Computerwoche, Olivetti-Server mit Pentium Pro nutzen Platinendesign von Intel, 22 December 1995
